headline: Through three games, Brock Purdy still hasn't been sacked
summary: The 49ers are the fourth team since 1990 to allow zero sacks in their first three games.

summary: The Titans lost two guards in Sunday’s loss to the Giants, and both are now headed for multi-game absences. headline: Ravens-Cowboys in Brazil averaged record 24.9M viewers
summary: The Ravens' 34-31 victory over the Cowboys in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, averaged 24.9 million viewers on CBS on Sunday, making it the most-watched NFL international game in history.
